invariants.rationale: Result is returned by execute(), so expected to be non-null in normal operation.
rollbackInstantTime is passed through to the action executor and likely required to identify what to roll back.
commitInstant is central for rollback operation, and is passed through to the underlying executor, so is expected non-null.
The method returns a HoodieRollbackMetadata, so result must be instance of this type.
context is required to execute rollback logic; the method does not mention handling null context.
